summary: A Yes vote raises the City of Simi Valley's transient occupancy tax on hotel and short-term lodging stays from 10% to 12%, with the revenue going to general city services.

tax.text: A Yes vote raises the hotel/short-term lodging tax from 10% to 12% to fund general city services.
tax.quote: Raises the hotel/short‑term lodging tax from 10% to 12% , paid by guests, to fund general city services (911, police, streets, senior services), about $400,000/year , until ended by voters.

tax.text: A No vote does not enact the proposed hotel/short-term lodging tax increase.
tax.quote: Raises the hotel/short‑term lodging tax from 10% to 12% , paid by guests, to fund general city services (911, police, streets, senior services), about $400,000/year , until ended by voters.
